overview_description.description:
Fondeadora is a provider of digital banking services used to eliminate the inefficiencies related to the traditional banking system. The company offers a completely free debit card linked to a powerful app to save, use, and manage money. Its first product is a mobile app and an international MasterCard debit card where anyone can pay, store, and distribute money without complications.

Fondeadora was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.

product.name: Digital Banking Account
product.description: A financial account that offers banking services digitally without the need for traditional bank branches.

product.name: Debit Card
product.description: A card linked to the user's digital banking account for making payments and withdrawals.

product.name: Elite Lounge Mastercard Access
product.description: Provides access to an exclusive lounge at AICM for World Elite Mastercard customers and their guests.

product.name: Elite Valet Service at AICM
product.description: Offers valet parking service at Mexico City International Airport, including car wash, for up to 5 days.

product.name: Extended Warranty
product.description: Doubles the original warranty of items purchased with the card for up to an additional year.

product.name: ATM Withdrawal Protection
product.description: Protection against theft or assault after using an ATM, covering up to $1,000 USD per incident.
